title: Signal-driven model procurement mapping and buyer-intent catalog
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a repeatable catalog and scoring model that maps real buyer-intent and usage signals (latency tolerance, price sensitivity, regulatory constraints, availability windows) to candidate models and procurement triggers. Purpose: give GTM, Solutions, and Provisioning teams an actionable feed that recommends which model variants to prioritize for Dedicated capacity, Reserved bids, or Private packaging based on imminent customer signals and regional supply risk.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Searchable catalog with >= 200 model-variant entries annotated for latency, quantization, license, regional availability, hardware affinity, and fallback compatibility. 2) Scoring function that outputs a procurement_recommendation per signal bucket with rationale fields. 3) Prototype feed delivered to Sales Ops Slack channel and Console project with weekly refresh. 4) Example runbooks for three buyer personas (PLG startup, mid-market SaaS, regulated enterprise).
tasks: Define buyer-intent signal taxonomy (latency bands, cost bands, SLA needs, privacy/regulation flags) - owner: PM
Inventory open models and vendor variants - owner: Research (include license string and quant support)
Annotate model entries with: region availability, preferred hardware (A100/H100/T4), quant modes tested, observed median p95 latency at 2k tokens - owner: Infra/Benchmarking
Design scoring rubric (availability risk, performance fit, cost-fit, license risk) and implement prototype in spreadsheet and simple service - owner: PM + Data Eng
Integrate with signals pipeline: wire synthetic customer signals from Sales/CS and public model-availability indicators - owner: Solutions + Research
Create Slack and Console integration proof-of-concept to surface recommendations - owner: Developer Experience
Write playbooks for provisioning paths: Dedicated reservation, burst capacity, or Private package - owner: PM + Solutions
Run 3 validation scenarios with historical incidents and show recommended procurement action - owner: PM, Infra SRE
